messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled phased deploy for inference-api -> v2.4.1. Change window Tue 2026-03-24 22:00-23:30 UTC. Plan: US (canary 0.5% -> 5%) -> EU (5%) -> APAC (5%). Rollback triggers: error rate >3% (5m) or p95 latency +200ms. Fallback image: registry/redwood/inference:v2.4.0. Initiator: @elia

elia: heads-up — coordinating capacity sanity checks before we flip the US canary. tagging eng-sre and ops. @mike @ops-oncall

mike: US GPU pool util 78% (target headroom ~20%). Estimated spare concurrency ~2.5k streams. Under 0.5% canary we expect +5-10% burst, should be fine but keep an eye on p95. If we see sustained p95 +150ms reduce to 0.2%.

sara: product ok with 0.5% to start. we'll run the eval set and synthetic traffic against canary. I'll post quick perf diffs.

deploy-bot: Canary launched (US) at 0.5% — autoscaler policy applied. More details: https://console/redwood/deploys/1783456789

infra-bot: exec output:
```
NODE               GPU_USED  GPU_TOTAL  MEM_USED  MEM_TOTAL
ap-northeast-1a     11 / 16   16         180Gi     256Gi
us-east-1a          12 / 16   16         200Gi     256Gi
eu-west-1b          9 / 16    16         150Gi     256Gi
```
Pods (inference-api): 120 desired, 118 ready, 2 restarting (OOM k8s).

ops-oncall: saw a transient p99 spike ~1200ms in us-east-1a ~10m ago. error rate stable. rolled one worker and restarted replica set — p99 dropped back to baseline. watching logs now.

jean: proposal: wait for US canary stability for 10m (no error increase, p95 within +100ms) before starting EU. If threshold breached anywhere (>2% error or p95 +150ms) then stop and rollback immediately. :raised_hands:

elia: ack. tentatively pin EU start to 22:25 UTC (10m after US start) — will not start earlier.

mike: APAC note — apac-gpu-2 undergoing infra maintenance until 04:00 UTC. APAC pool capacity currently reduced ~30%. Recommend delaying APAC to next morning (04:30 UTC) rather than risk degraded experience.

sara: agree on delay. we'll note bypass routing and potential latency bump in tonight's release notes for customers.

deploy-bot: Alert: rollback threshold breached in US canary — error rate 3.8% (5m window). Initiating automated rollback to registry/redwood/inference:v2.4.0 for US region. Notifying owners: @elia @mike.

elia: on it — rolling back US canary now. grabbing logs and traces. please hold EU and APAC rollouts.

infra-bot: recent tracer snippets:
```
[2026-03-24T22:12:04Z] inference-api pod/inference-rc-xyz - model load timeout 12.3s - path: /models/q8_optimized/prefetch
[2026-03-24T22:12:05Z] kernel oom_kill event on gpu0 - pid 24431
[2026-03-24T22:12:06Z] batch_worker crashed (SIGKILL) - mem footprint 14.8Gi
```
Suspect: v2.4.1 prefetch path triggers higher transient memory use for certain long-context prompts (>=2048 tokens).

mike: confirmed from node logs. action: keep US on v2.4.0, block EU/APAC. We'll prepare a hotfix that disables prefetch path in v2.4.1 or gates it behind feature flag.

jean: agreed — block APAC tonight. update release notes and the scheduled deployment calendar. i'll mark the change window as partially aborted for non-US regions. :white_check_mark:

elia: thanks — plan: abort EU/APAC for tonight, create hotfix branch (hotfix/model-prefetch-fix), run internal perf tests, and re-run phased deploy after validation. I'll open the PR and tag @mike @infra for review. Closing this thread and will reopen a new one when ready.

sara: noted — I'll update the customer-facing release note and internal rollout doc with the delayed APAC timeline.

deploy-bot: US rollback to v2.4.0 complete. Canary traffic back to baseline. All automated checks green.

elia: closing — good job everyone. we'll reschedule APAC once hotfix validated. Thanks for quick triage. :heart:
